reason: The README clearly describes a dsh plugin that detects sensitive values in model requests, replaces them with placeholders before transmission, and restores eligible streamed responses and tool arguments locally; it does not access user files or make its own network calls.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 dsh 模型请求发送前检测并替换敏感值为占位符，并在本地流式恢复适用的响应内容和工具参数。
summaries.en: This plugin detects sensitive values in dsh model requests, replaces them with placeholders before transmission, and locally restores eligible streamed responses and tool arguments.

capabilities: Intercepts dsh model requests at the llm/stream layer
Detects and replaces configured sensitive data with placeholders
Transforms text, reasoning blocks, tool results, and tool-call arguments
Restores eligible response content and assembled tool arguments locally
Maintains placeholder mappings in process memory
Provides masking status and local verification commands
